latest_candidate_failure.failure: The test ab_repeat_observes_points_and_wraps_playback completed its playback assertions, then the test process exited with 0xc0000005 (STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION) during player shutdown. Package assembly and publish were skipped.
latest_candidate_failure.evidence: A hosted mini dump identifies libmpv-2.dll+0xf4a510 calling a COM vtable slot at offset 0x38 into the unloaded MMDevApi.dll range. This matches the engine audio-device notification unregister path. Request draining and callback removal completed before the fault. Neither null audio output nor retaining the native module resolved it.
latest_candidate_failure.resolution: A Windows-only COM MTA guard now covers playback-worker creation through native core destruction. It balances successful initialization on the same worker thread and cannot move across threads. The full native suite, extracted-package test, and binary/source audit remain required. Hosted verification is pending.
latest_candidate_failure.local_verification: 44 native tests pass against release libmpv SHA-256 1749e6b5519afa383c88442e97026754e4e169bd46107ecc0ab0b08d205ad0af with mpv null output. The exact runtime manifest and 15 package regressions pass locally.
latest_candidate_failure.next_action: Verify the Windows COM lifetime change on the hosted runner; publish only after complete playback and exact binary/source audit pass.
